data.topic: AI agent self-learning and behavioral conditioning — persistent memory architectures, correction-to-preference pipelines, decision-outcome correlation, hook/guardrail generation from patterns, inference-time RLHF alternatives
in_scope: Memory architectures for LLM agents (MemGPT, Letta, LangMem)
out_of_scope: Training-time RLHF (PPO, DPO, reward model training)
data.problem: Current memory pipeline records corrections and displays them but doesn't close the feedback loop — no decision correlation, no enforcement hooks, no behavioral conditioning beyond text injection
data.why: Without a closed loop, corrections don't actually change behavior, and the same mistakes repeat across sessions
data.end_goal: Understand how mature systems solve this problem to inform our refactor
data.complexity_reasoning: External domain research needed — MemGPT, Letta, LangMem, and inference-time feedback systems are outside this codebase's knowledge
